summary: Build skills gap analyses, learning pathways, and measurable capability plans in this practical 5-day course.
lede: A workforce reskilling and upskilling strategy helps HR, learning and workforce-planning professionals identify capability gaps and plan development for changing roles. The course covers skills mapping, future-skill prioritization, role-based learning pathways, and tracking skill progression, transfer to work, and internal mobility. Participants also explore governance and reporting to align capability plans with business change and talent decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workforce capability, learning investment, and internal mobility strategy across changing roles and skill demands.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of HR, learning and development, workforce planning, talent management, or organizational development. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet analysis and headcount or learning data will help, but no coding is required. The course uses practical templates and guided exercises, so you should be ready to work with skills matrices, learning pathway drafts, and reporting formats. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted skills inference are covered at an operational level, while implementation remains focused on tools, templates, and decision workflows you can adapt in your own organization.
